about_the_game:
Explore the world of Duriano through the official Digital Artbook!

This DLC features a curated collection of high-resolution artworks from the development of Duriano, including:

  • Character designs and concept sketches

  • Environments and world-building illustrations

  • Early stage development art

Presented in a digital format for easy viewing, this Artbook offers a behind-the-scenes look into the creative process behind Duriano.

Note: This Artbook is a digital download and does not add or modify gameplay content.

To find the content after installing:

Right-click on Duriano in your Steam games library, and select ‘Properties…’ Under the Local Files tab click ‘Browse…’ – this will open the install folder, and the Duriano Digital Artbook can be found in the folder called 'Digital Artbook'.
